correctness.rationale: Explicit Fourier expansion proves \(A_k=A_{-k}A_{2k}\) and invertibility for \(\gcd(n,q)=1\). Active-orbit cancellation and root-exponent derivation are exact; Frobenius cycles force three necessary and sufficient power equations. The multiplicative group of \(\mathbb F_{q^s}\) has exactly the computed number of common roots. Ten nonsplit cases were independently exhaustively enumerated in native multiplication, with split Fourier replay checks.

value.rationale: A complete bijective census of idempotents for arbitrary odd cyclic dihedral quandles and all finite fields in the coprime-characteristic regime is a natural nonassociative-algebra invariant. New Galois-orbit factors account quantitatively for nonsplit fields and observed arithmetic count jumps in the same eleven-element algebra; the result is not an arbitrary isolated finite computation.
